description.value: Canyon Alpine Motel is a roadside motel located on the Trans-Canada Highway in the Okanagan & Thompson region of British Columbia. Its highway-side position makes it a potential overnight stop for cyclists travelling the corridor. Current operational status cannot be confirmed as the motel's website domain appears to have been taken over by an unrelated third party.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL listed in OSM (https://www.canyonalpinemotel.ca/) now resolves to an entirely unrelated online casino site (Kyngs Casino Canada), indicating the domain has either expired and been re-registered or otherwise hijacked — no motel content is present. Because the website cannot be used as evidence for any amenity or operational detail, all amenity fields default to null. OSM provides basic identifiers (phone, email, address) and the tag internet_access=wlan, but per the rules, OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website confirmation.
